subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class per-user token usage accounting in core, and which authenticated principal should usage be attributed to?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent design crosses identity, privacy, storage, Gateway RPC, Dashboard, and billing/quota semantics in a security-sensitive area.

options.title: Design Core Identity Accounting
options.body: Define user principal, authorized readers, storage schema, aggregation RPCs, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, retention, and redaction before implementation.

options.title: Use External Reporting First
options.body: Keep core usage scoped to session, agent, channel, model, and provider while front layers or plugins build user billing reports from explicit identity mappings.

options.title: Keep Single-Operator Scope
options.body: Decline core multi-user accounting for now and continue improving existing session, agent, and provider usage surfaces.

recommendation.title: Design Core Identity Accounting
recommendation.body: Define user principal, authorized readers, storage schema, aggregation RPCs, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, retention, and redaction before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest usage/cost surface history and can route the identity/security half to Gateway auth owners.
